title: Covariance, branch symmetry, time reversal, and recovery properties
question: Do the implemented closure and field equations preserve rotational and Lorentz covariance, coherence-sign symmetry, reversible time parity, and nonzero-coupling primitive round trips?
prediction: All covariance and discrete-symmetry residuals remain below 2e-9 across 32 seeded states, all 64 production recovery round trips succeed, and maximum primitive error remains below 1e-9.
falsifier: Any covariance, branch, time-parity, or recovery criterion exceeds its registered tolerance or any random recovery fails.
controls: Random spatial transformations are proper orthogonal matrices with determinant plus one.
Lorentz covariance compares the independently reevaluated stress with the transformed four-tensor.
Coherence sign reversal requires even stress and constitutive fields, odd scalar derivatives, and identical characteristic spectra.
Time reversal uses the canonical parities of material velocities, scalar Pi, vector potentials, electric momenta, longitudinal charges, and cleaners.
Recovery begins from conserved data generated by the same canonical action but is solved through the independent nonlinear recovery path.
seed_rationale: Rotations, boosts, physical states, and recovery states are generated from a fixed NumPy seed.
